S0 927c099 (feat/seam-tests, worktree ~/upready/worktrees/upready-store/feat/seam-tests, :8002): seam map registry docs/testing/seam-map.json rendered to seam-map.md, 54 rows (H-I 19, I-S 22, S-S 9, X 4), entry points checked by docs/testing/render-seam-map.mjs (0 problems). Measured: 24 pages, 5 layouts, 2 api routes, 14 lib/data files with 65 exports, 11 getCartId() sites, 2 backend custom routes, 11 subscribers, 0 workflows/jobs/links, 11 email templates, 0 existing tests. DB (17b): jest.config.js:2 loadEnv(test) falls back to .env (upready_store) but @medusajs/test-utils medusa-test-runner-utils/config.js:20 overrides databaseUrl with a temp DB medusa-<name>-integration-<worker> from DB_HOST/DB_PORT/DB_USERNAME (database.js:22-29); defaults are localhost:5432, ours is 127.0.0.1:5433, so suites run with those exported inline; dev DB never used. Note: task state in HANDOFF.json is backlog (task show) though the launch message said approved; left as is (22j).

S2 backend (partial): integration-tests/http/custom-routes.spec.ts green 4/4 on a temp DB (run 5), covers both custom routes (count 2: store/custom, admin/custom) with a publishable key from Modules.API_KEY and an admin token via register → link auth identity to a user (Modules.AUTH updateAuthIdentities app_metadata.user_id) → login, because POST /admin/users refuses a registration token with 401 in 2.19. Test-infra defects fixed in jest.config.js (not product): transform and moduleFileExtensions lacked tsx, so no jest suite could boot the app (emails are .tsx); the runner needs DB_HOST=localhost literally (test-utils config.js:24 turns SSL on for any other host) and PORT unset (.env PORT=9022 collides with the shared backend; spec passes env {PORT: ''}). Command: PORT= DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5433 DB_USERNAME=ivanprotsko DB_PASSWORD= corepack pnpm test:integration:http. tsc 0 errors, medusa lint exit 0. Reverse run (store route 200→204) in progress at save time. Workflow wf_f7f0fad1-25a (S1 registry, subscriber unit tests, emails/smtp/config/seed unit tests) still running.
